'''Rearguard Base''' is an area of {{Location|Desorock Highland}}.

==Description==
The Rearguard Base is a large area filled with military encampments. [[Midnight Rangers]] can be found on patrol almost constantly; as such, there are notably fewer [[TD]]s than the neighboring regions. This relative safety also has allowed several [[Exiles|Exile]] camps to appear.

==Features==
Two of the [[Torn Pages from Desorock Highland]] can be found here. One is at the large base near the [[Resonance Nexus]], one near an [[Exiles|Exile]] encampment north of the base.
